scope: Primary-source dictionary and independently pinned numeric-structure audit only; no event-rate estimation, matrix-derived biological results, patient prediction or contact with authors.

input_workbook.schema_provenance: Workbook structure verified in the preceding validation-route audit; root independently pinned and inspected numeric arrays in workbook-structure.json and encoding-checks.json.

supplementary_information.inspection: Native PDF text searched for imaging, tracking, frames, sister selection, censoring and matrix-size terms. No Figure 1b column-time or event-export dictionary found. Transcriptomic lineage analyses in this supplement are not the microscopy export.

reporting_summary.inspection: Image-based PDF; page text inspected with native OCR. Broad replication/randomization statements do not assign these matrix rows to experimental replicates.

time_dictionary.source_schedule_locator: Author manuscript, Methods: Live cell imaging

independent_consistency_arithmetic.assumptions: Exactly 0 through 336 hours, t=0 included, stated intervals, no duplicate boundary frames

time_dictionary.interpretation: Neither 2025 uniform ten-minute frames nor an exact 14-day rescaling is source-certified. Resampling, interpolation, padding, unequal starts/stops or a separate export grid remain possibilities, not findings.
missing: Actual timestamp vector or original image database
Treatment start offset and exact observation end
Handling of missing frames and duplicated boundaries

selection_dictionary.reported_persister_definition: Alive at day 14 in this imaging experiment; endpoint phenotype, not continuous functional drug-tolerance classification.
selection_dictionary.nonpersister_tracking: Starts from movie beginning; only one representative branch per progeny, with a sister selected randomly at divisions.
selection_dictionary.persister_ascertainment: Every final-frame cell is initially traced backward to identify its day-0 founder; a single path per lineage/timepoint is then tracked forward to limit overrepresentation of large progenies.
selection_dictionary.extended_data_legend_nuance: Extended Data Figure 1b says the found initiator is tracked forward 'as in a'. This supports forward re-tracking but does not provide an Oren export algorithm or a fully explicit chosen-sister rule in the selected persister subset.
unresolved: How prospective and retrospectively ascertained rows were merged and deduplicated
Whether selected persister forward paths can end in death while a different branch survives
Exact chosen-sister sampling rule and seed for those paths
Complete initial eligible-founder denominator and any field/track exclusions
Inclusion probabilities for each row and whether endpoint selection changed sampling weights
selection_dictionary.denominator_caution: The Figure 1b counts and narrative approximate percentages are insufficient to reconstruct an unconditional initial-population sampling denominator. Do not use 77/1135 as a certified population persistence estimate.
selection_dictionary.lineage_vs_cell_caution: A row is a selected lineage path, not a full expanding population or necessarily a complete binary family tree. A selected path's death does not automatically establish extinction of all descendants.

cycle_time_dictionary.displayed_unit: hours, verified visually on publisher Figure 1c x-axis; y-axis is non-division probability
cycle_time_dictionary.source_method_untreated: Interval between first and second mitoses.
cycle_time_dictionary.source_method_persister: Intervals beginning at the first mitosis after 72 hours of treatment and subsequent mitoses, averaged; intended to omit early events before drug uptake.
cycle_time_dictionary.censoring_code_0_1_meaning: UNKNOWN: field name does not specify which value means observed/censored or the censoring time.
unknown: Handling of cells with no eligible mitosis or incomplete terminal cycles
Left truncation and interval aggregation rules in the actual export
Whether censoring is administrative, tracking loss or another reason
cycle_time_dictionary.boundary: These filtered/averaged intervals must not be silently pooled with all birth-to-division intervals or used as an unbiased untreated-versus-persister hazard comparison.

identity_replication_censoring.row_ids_and_joins: No explicit lineage/cell identifiers verified in the two numeric matrix headers. The Figure 1d first column differs from the terminal death-matrix code at 146 positions despite matching row and category counts. Neither equality of counts nor positional comparison certifies a biological row join.
identity_replication_censoring.replicate_ids: No matrix-row to movie, field, well, date or biological-experiment mapping verified.
identity_replication_censoring.reported_replication: Reporting-summary OCR states n at least 3 for all experiments, most experiments repeated at least twice with n=3, and two single-cell samples at days 3, 7 and 14. Those broad statements do not identify the microscopy rows' replicate memberships; sequencing replicates must not be assigned to movie rows.
identity_replication_censoring.figure_legend_limit: The Figure 1 legend explicitly associates three biological replicates with growth/response summaries and representative images. It does not supply track-level replicate assignments.
identity_replication_censoring.tracking_loss_vs_death: Methods report manual death recording; no explicit tracking-loss/exclusion/censoring table was located.
identity_replication_censoring.at_risk_mask: Not certified. Zero event entries alone do not establish that a cell was observable, alive or at risk.
identity_replication_censoring.withdrawal_state_labels: No repeated withdrawal-sensitive/tolerant transition label sequence verified. This is continued-treatment tracking, not direct validation of the post-withdrawal v2 model.

structural_reconciliation_from_root_audi.evidence_class: Derived numerical observations from the pinned workbook; distinguish these from paper statements and study-specific export provenance.

division.interpretation: All observed changes are nondecreasing unit steps. This is compatible with a cumulative-count encoding, not raw isolated binary event spikes; the study-specific transform and five initial ones remain unresolved. The 1668 increments exclude initial-column values and must not be relabeled a biological event total.

death.interpretation: Each row starts at zero and has at most one transition to a persistent one. This certifies the numerical step pattern, not a documented death/observation/at-risk convention or exact event time.

figure1d.evidence_class: Header is affirmative workbook text; counts and range are derived numeric observations.
figure1d.interpretation: The source header labels zero as persister within this table. It does not establish correspondence to death-matrix rows or explain the Figure 1b 77-row subset.

unverified_positional_join.comparison: Figure1d first column versus terminal death-matrix code, same row number; identity/order not certified
unverified_positional_join.interpretation: Agreement or disagreement by position cannot establish a biological row join.

structural_reconciliation_from_root_audi.interpretation_limit: Figure 1d has 80 explicitly zero-labeled persister entries; the death matrix independently has 80 terminal zeros; Figure 1b reports 77 persister lineages. The matching counts do not certify matching rows: 146 positional comparisons differ. No intended correction, source error, missing-label assignment or biological meaning of these discrepancies is inferred. Need row identities, selection/exclusions and export provenance.

official_software_evidence.license: No explicit licence reported in repository metadata.
official_software_evidence.semantic_scope: The following are exact conventions of inspected generic functions. They are conditional clues, NOT certified meanings of the Oren workbook cells.

files.meaning: Initializes all entries to zero; sets one at timepoints with a recorded event centroid for a tracked cell. Does not provide an observation mask.
For each input entry equal to one, increments that row from the event column through the end; output is cumulative event count.
Can export cell_id, centroid_col, centroid_row, timepoint, division, death, value; binary division/death flags refer to recorded event centroids.

Uses the division event builder for both division and death annotations. Separately retains raw/lineage-filled event arrays, traces, lineageTree, centroid coordinates and cellAnnotation containing group, position and tracked-cell ID.
Copies pre-division trace information between linked branches; filled arrays can repeat ancestral history and must not automatically be counted as independent events.
Randomly retains one entry for each repeated progenitor identifier; actual use for Oren's published rows was not verified.
Parses filename/group/channel/position/timepoint from microscopy filenames; integer timepoint is not itself a verified elapsed-time vector.

possible_missing_companion_objects: Original image database and elapsed timestamps
Study-specific plotting/export script and row-selection indices

specific_workbook_codes.division_sheet: STRUCTURAL_PATTERN_VERIFIED_SEMANTICS_PARTIAL: codes 0 through 7 are nondecreasing with 1668 unit increments and five initial ones. Raw isolated binary-spike encoding is incompatible with these observed values. Cumulative-type structure is supported, but study-specific event definition, initial-state handling, lineage filling, observation coverage and timestamp mapping remain unknown.
specific_workbook_codes.death_sheet: STRUCTURAL_PATTERN_VERIFIED_SEMANTICS_PARTIAL: all rows begin at zero; 1055 rows transition once to persistent one and 80 stay zero. It is a numerical persistent-step array, not an isolated event-spike array. Exact biological/missing-observation semantics, export transform, observation mask and frame timing remain uncertified.

watermelon_repository_check.finding: Inspected official code inventory contains lineage-barcode processing scripts and transcriptomic RDS pointers; no Figure 1b microscopy export dictionary located. The two listed public issues concern RDS access and barcode processing, not this matrix dictionary.

minimum_gates_before_hazard_analysis: Certify exact elapsed-time mapping for every matrix column.
Certify event-code meanings and an observation/at-risk mask, separately from event absence.
Resolve the five initial division ones and certify whether, and how, first differences correspond to eligible observed events; do not count pre-window or unknown-baseline events by assumption.
Certify row identity, selection provenance and whether a row is a surviving spine or a newly chosen random forward path.
Require explicit row identifiers and certified joins across Figure 1b matrices and Figure 1d; the equal counts conceal 146 positional disagreements.
Resolve field/experiment grouping and any repeated ancestral histories.
Identify track-loss and administrative censoring, plus a verified codebook for Figure 1c.
State the estimand conditional on the actual selection design; do not relabel selected-path hazards as population or state-exit hazards.
permitted_current_use: Structural validation, provenance checks, selected-data descriptions with explicit unidentified fields, and independent synthetic selection demonstrations. No biological event-rate claim is supplied by this dictionary audit.
